requirements:
The website must be responsive and work on multiple devices.

The site must feature a shared header with logo, navigation menu, search bar, and a cart section showing item count and subtotal.

The site must have a consistent footer across all pages.

files.name: - index.html   - shop.html   - cart.html   - checkout.html   - about.html   - styles.css   - script.js   - products.json
files.path: output/tech-gadget-store/- index.html   - shop.html   - cart.html   - checkout.html   - about.html   - styles.css   - script.js   - products.json

shared_components: Header with search bar (#search-input) and cart section (#cart-count, #cart-subtotal)
Footer with company info, navigation links, and contact information
